title: Over 50 killed as Houthis target Yemen military camp with ballistic missiles
summary_full: A deadly Houthi missile attack on a military training camp in Shabwa province killed at least 50 coalition fighters. The attack also resulted in over two dozen troops wounded, according to military officials. Following the strikes, Yemeni forces reported recapturing territory in Taiz governorate, while Houthi forces continued their offensive. In another incident, a coalition airstrike killed nine people, including children and women, in Saada.
